title: How Rob Hallam built SuperX to $13K MRR by building in public on X
summary: Rob Hallam went from five products earning $0 to a $13K MRR SaaS (SuperX) by sharing his story on X and then using data to systemize virality. He lays out a seven-step playbook: profile foundation, one goal, a four-part content loop, copying concepts not posts, doubling down on winners, real connections, and following the platform's format.

principles.text: Distribution, day-one monetization and painkillers over vitamins are the lessons from five failed products.
principles.quote: Firstly, that distribution matters. Secondly, that monetization matters from day one. And thirdly, that you need to focus on building painkillers, not vitamins.

principles.text: Honest, vulnerable storytelling builds an audience in an age of AI slop.
principles.quote: So if you go on X and you share your story, your personality honestly and vulnerably, that is how you build an audience in 2025.

principles.text: Sequence content as a loop: entertain for reach, educate or sell, then inspire, and repeat.
principles.quote: your content should be four types. entertaining, educational, inspirational, and convincing.

principles.text: Mine top posts in your niche for the underlying concept, then rebuild it in your own style.
principles.quote: identify the concept, most importantly the concept, not the actual post that worked.

principles.text: Track every post, double down on winners, and kill things that don't work even if they went viral.
principles.quote: kill what doesn't, even if it went viral.

principles.text: Grow through a few genuine relationships with valuable replies, not spammed generic comments.
principles.quote: you want to find people in your niche, in your community that you genuinely want to connect with and make friends with and then reply with real value.
